relations.myth: Recovery of the chief’s severed arm
relations.note: Iktomi throws him into a boiling pot; Falling Star overturns it and scalds him.

relations.myth: Recovery of the chief’s severed arm
relations.note: He scalds the Thunder-beings, recovers the stolen arm, and escapes their storm.

relations.myth: The Stone Boy and the Spider
relations.note: The manuscript title attests a joint narrative, but the interaction and Spider’s identity remain uncertain.
relations.source: Allison, The Stone Boy and the Spider

relations.note: Cajete interprets Stone Boy as primordial Iŋyáŋ come to life on earth.
Stone Boy withstands Iya’s poison, blows, and deception, then defeats him.
Stone Boy flattens Iya’s hands and feet, interrogates him, and later tramples him.
Under duress, Iya reveals how Stone Boy can restore the flattened victims.
